page_title: ATA 1-1 LEC | Atalanta v Lecce 27/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Federico La Penna has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' The resulting corner from Antonino Gallo (Lecce) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
88' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
87' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
85' Marco Giampaolo has decided to substitute Ante Rebic and he is replaced by Rares Burnete (Lecce).
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) will replace Balthazar Pierret.
85' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
83' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
82' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atalanta comes to nothing.
80' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Ederson is replaced by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
80' It will be a substitution. Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) is ready to enter the pitch as Mateo Retegui walks off.
80' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Corner kick. Atalanta will have an opportunity.
80' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Federico La Penna who sees an offensive foul.
78' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) for his blatant foul.
78' The corner kick from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

78' Atalanta have a corner. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
76' Substitution. Santiago Pierotti walks off the pitch and Danilo Veiga (Lecce) comes on as a substitute.
72' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the right post!
70' Marco Giampaolo decides to make a substitution. Jesper Karlsson will be replaced by Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce).
69' 1 - 1 Goal! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Wladimiro Falcone to commit before slotting the penalty low into the middle of the goal.
69' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
68' Federico La Penna blows the whistle, Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) is penalised for a foul. Atalanta are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
64' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mario Pasalic walks off the pitch to be replaced by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta).

63' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) produces a shot from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His effort sails narrowly over the crossbar. The goalkeeper was lucky there. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.

62' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Isak Hien (Atalanta). Federico La Penna saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Lecce earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
60' That will be all from Odilon Kossounou who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta).
57' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
56' Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
54' Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Davide Zappacosta.
52' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) takes the corner but it's cleared.
52' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.
50' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
49' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.
48' Federico La Penna blows for a foul after Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
48' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
48' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Atalanta get a corner.
46' Half-time substitution. Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) is replaced by Juan Cuadrado.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Wladimiro Falcone makes a great save.
45+2' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
45+1' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
45+1' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Atalanta.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
41' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) attempts to find Ademola Lookman, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
41' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
38' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.

37' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Wladimiro Falcone, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
34' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

33' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Mario Pasalic collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Atalanta will take a corner.
29' 0 - 1 Goal! Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty low past Marco Carnesecchi into the middle of the goal.
29' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) is going to take the penalty!
29' It’s a PENALTY to Lecce after the VAR review!
28' Referee Federico La Penna makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Lecce. Let’s see what happens!
27' Isak Hien (Atalanta) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!

27' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the left post. It would have probably ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Marco Carnesecchi and his brilliant save.
25' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
25' Ante Rebic (Lecce) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post.
25' Lecce force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

24' Nice individual effort by Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the bottom right corner, but Marco Carnesecchi does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out. The ball goes out of play. Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
21' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
19' Dangerous play by Jesper Karlsson (Lecce). Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
17' The game is interrupted.
16' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
15' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Now Atalanta have a corner.
14' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
12' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
12' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta).

12' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

10' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
8' Federico La Penna has a clear sight and sees a foul from Mateo Retegui (Atalanta).
7' The ball is played back to Mateo Retegui (Atalanta), who controls it instantly and releases a piledriver from long range, but the shot lacks accuracy and drifts well wide of the left post.

6' What a save from Wladimiro Falcone! Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
5' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
3' Neat passing move from Lecce in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lecce will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Federico La Penna.
